body:
# aggregator(activity): summary caps split surrogate pairs — watchdog/kaneo writers and the record-time cap raw-slice at 500, bypassing the #7694/#7711 capUnits guard

## Problem

`pm-stack/aggregator/src/activity.ts` caps activity summaries with raw `slice(0, 500)` at four sites, none of them pair-safe:

- line 120 — `watchdogDeliveries`: `summary: item.title.slice(0, 500)`
- line 196 — `kaneoChangeDeliveries` (appeared): composed summary `.slice(0, 500)`
- line 207 — `kaneoChangeDeliveries` (moved): composed summary `.slice(0, 500)`
- line 485 — the ingestion record: `summary: (d.link ? `${d.summary} — ${d.link}` : d.summary).slice(0, 500)` — a second cap applied at persist time, so even a pair fully inside a writer's 500 can be split when the ` — link` suffix pushes the boundary into it.

This is the #3178 defect class that #7694 fixed for `actions.ts` `cleanText` and #7711 fixed for `markResult` (both merged 2026-11-08) via the `capUnits` helper (actions.ts:292, not exported): an astral character straddling the cap is dropped whole. The activity writers were not audited in either fix. Summaries are persisted through `events.record` (line 478-486) into the activity stream and rendered on the board, so a split pair is stored, not just displayed: the stored summary ends in a lone high surrogate, and any UTF-8 round-trip (file write, HTTP response) replaces it with U+FFFD.

## Evidence (verified this run, laptop primary @ f9dfb4cfa5, real module md5 1512d949c61186d2cdec988887197654)

Probe `~/git/fleet/probe-activity-surrogate/probe.ts` (bun, imports the real `activity.ts`):

```
watchdog straddle | len: 500 | last unit: 0xd83d | lone high surrogate at end: true  | utf8 roundtrip changes: true | roundtrip last: 0xfffd
watchdog control  | len: 500 | last unit: 0xde00 | lone high surrogate at end: false | utf8 roundtrip changes: false
kaneo straddle    | len: 500 | last unit: 0xd83d | lone high surrogate at end: true  | utf8 roundtrip changes: true | roundtrip last: 0xfffd
```

- Straddle case (watchdog): title = 499 × `x` + 😀 + tail → `watchdogDeliveries` summary is 500 units ending in lone `\ud83d`.
- Straddle case (kaneo): card title padded so the pair straddles the composed summary's 500 cap → same lone `\ud83d` ending.
- Control: 498 × `x` + 😀 (pair fully inside the cap) → summary intact, round-trips cleanly.

Dedup: searches for "activity surrogate", "watchdogDeliveries", and "kaneo summary" (open + closed) return no issue for these caps; #7694/#7711 cover `actions.ts` only (filed and fixed this morning; this is the residual door in the sibling module).

## Why it matters

- Watchdog titles and Kaneo card titles are operator/user text — emoji in a card title at the wrong offset permanently corrupts the stored activity record's summary (U+FFFD in the persisted stream), the same failure #7694/#7711 were filed for in `actions.ts`.
- The record-time cap (line 485) makes the writers' own caps insufficient as a fix location: the persist path must be pair-safe too.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All four summary caps in `activity.ts` (lines 120, 196, 207, 485) are surrogate-pair-safe: an astral character straddling the 500-unit cap is dropped whole, never split (mirroring `capUnits` semantics from #7711).
- [ ] Regression tests in the aggregator suite pin the straddle case for the watchdog writer, a kaneo writer, and the record-time cap, plus an exact-fit control (pair fully inside the cap stays intact); the new tests fail on the pre-fix code.
- [ ] The existing aggregator test suite stays green.
